# validate_rich_content_tool

> Validate a chart or card before you post it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `utility` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=validate_rich_content_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Validate a chart or card before you post it. Pass either your whole draft reply
(containing one or more ```pm-artifact blocks) or just the JSON of one block.

Returns `valid` plus, per block, `ok`, `problems` (path + message; fix these and
validate again) and a `summary` (title and kind) of what PortableMind will draw.
A block with problems marked `dropped` still renders, minus the dropped part.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string | yes | Your draft reply containing ```pm-artifact blocks, or the JSON of a single block. |

  ]
}
